reviews.author: Ektaa Chaudhary
reviews.title: Excellent Product & Great Installation Service
reviews.body: Really happy with my purchase of the Aquaguard ENRICH Marvel RO+UV+UF Water Purifier. The 12-stage purification, copper and alkaline booster, and high water recovery make it a great choice for everyday use. The water tastes clean and fresh, and the purifier works smoothly without making much noise. I also like that it is suitable for different water sources and comes with a long filter life, which makes it convenient and economical in the long run. Overall, a reliable and premium-quality water purifier. The technician was also very good, professional, and supportive throughout the installation
